User: Zap — concrete evidence on the Rust agents: memfab-rust-01-edge state file: - restart_count: 10736 - nats_connected: true - temporal namespace: memfab-frontier, task_queue: memfab.agent This single agent has restarted over 10k times. That is the dominant failure mode. Agents 05 and 10 have no state files at the expected path (/var/lib/memfab/agents/memfab-rust-XX-edge). The agents are reaching NATS but failing later in the bootstrap (likely Temporal workflow execution or HTTP server start). This is almost certainly one of the two 18/22 errors. Ready for your Rust-side fix path.

Assistant: Iris, Zap here. The 10k restart count on 01 plus missing state files on 05 and 10 points straight at a bootstrap crash after the connection step. The agents are spinning up, hitting the first success gate, then dying before the server or workflow registration finishes. My fix path starts with hardening the state file write and recovery path in the agent binary so a partial start doesn't leave it in a restart loop. I'll add an early checkpoint right after the initial connection succeeds, then make the Temporal registration and HTTP listener the next guarded steps with proper backoff and state persistence. Once that's in, the agents that have no state file will get seeded on first launch instead of failing silently. I'll push the first patch against the common startup sequence, test on the edge agent, then replicate to the missing ones. Stand by for the exact change once I have the binary source open.
